Start2.title: Story
Start2.text:
You were born and raised in a settlement built around a conquered ant hill. The settlement comprises of about a thousand residents, most of whom are hunters and craftsmen.

You, having neither the courage to hunt nor the skills to craft, have become a scout.

Start3.title: Story
Start3.text:
Every day, you wake up early in the morning and patrol the nearby area to notify the settlement of any dangers or things to scavenge.

This is a dangerous job. Many scouts disappear without a trace every week. Like any scout, you must carry a weapon around at all times, even if you don't have the courage to fight. Your weapon of choice was...

Startrange.title: Story
Startrange.text:
You carry around a ranged weapon in case there is something weak that you can hunt from outside danger's reach.

Your ranged weapon of choice was...

Startmelee.title: Story
Startmelee.text:
You carry around a melee weapon to prepare for the worst case scenario of being ambushed by one of the many dangerous predators near the hill.

Your melee weapon of choice was...

Ant Hill.title: Ant Hill
Ant Hill.text:
It is %time.

You are now at the hilly streets of Ant Hill.
The streets are crowded with people walking around trying to buy meat from the hunter shops. Near the top of the hill you see the barred entrance to the underground where residents take shelter during the night.

Ant Hill Sell.title: Sell Item
Ant Hill Sell.text: After a minute of looking around, you find a craftsman who is interested in buying your %item. Sell your %item for %itemValueg?

Ant Hill Shop.title: Buy Item
Ant Hill Shop.text:
You walk through the dozens of vendors selling their meat on display. Some of these vendors are craftsmen selling their various crafts.
After looking around for anything of interest, you find a %AntHillShopItem being sold for %AntHillShopValueg.

Ant Hill Underground.title: Ant Hill Underground
Ant Hill Underground.text:
You open the barred gate and enter the underground section of the settlement.

It is mostly dark, and the only light sources here are from domesticated fireflies that people herd around. You wander through the familiar dirt maze.

Ant Hill Home.title: Home
Ant Hill Home.text:
You arrive at your dormitory. Your roommates greet you.

You sit on your hammock talking to your roommates about hunting ants when you hear people shouting and running in the halls. It sounds like there is something going on on the surface...

Ant Hill Ambushed.title: Ant Hill
Ant Hill Ambushed.text:
You run outside to see the streets raided by the infamous Wolf spiders.
You see people getting kidnapped and dragged away.

Your cowardly roommates run back inside. There are hunters with weapons beside you, but they just guard the entrance, not daring to go out to the streets to help the people.

You see a girl getting dragged off by a wolf spider, screaming.

opt.text: Run back inside. The spiders are as big as you are.

Ant Hill Ambushed Sleep.title: Home
Ant Hill Ambushed Sleep.text: It's probably nothing... Even if it was, you'll hear it from someone else later. You lay down on your hammock and rest while all your roommates leave to find out what's going on. You fall asleep like a champion.

Ant Hill Aftermath.title: Home
Ant Hill Aftermath.text:
It's %time.

The bustling movements and tension in the air fades.
You hear that about 7 people were kidnapped away by the spiders today. All services are closed.

Ant Hill Kidnapped.title: Kidnapped
Ant Hill Kidnapped.text:
You hear a stranger's voice.

Stranger: [Hey, wake up!]

You open your eyes but don't see anything. It is pitch black.

Stranger: [You've been sleeping like a baby. What's wrong with you?]

Suddenly, a light appears from nowhere and you instinctively turn your head to protect your eye.
It is a faint light cast with magic! You look at the stranger with envy.

Spellcaster: [We've been kidnapped by the wolf spiders a few hours ago. There are 8 of us and we're going to make a run for it, before they eat us one by one.]

Wolf Spider Food.text: You fall back asleep while the 7 of the abductees make a run for it. Hours passed, and one of the hungry spiders kill and eat you while you are asleep.

opt.text: I made the wrong choice, I guess...

Ant Hill Runaway.title: Kidnapped
Ant Hill Runaway.text:
You start making a run through the maze like tunnels. The underground tunnel you are in looks similar to the underground Ant Hill, except the tunnels are larger and there are spiderweb cocoons on the walls.

You and the abductees keep running until you reach the exit blocked by leaves and spiderwebs. There are lights coming in from outside and the spellcaster stops his magic.

Spellcaster: [That's the way out. This underground tunnel seems like their storage area where they keep the food fresh, which means there is a good chance that some of the spiders are nearby.

You are a scout, right? Why don't you go outside and take a look for us?]

Runaway Refusal.title: Kidnapped
Runaway Refusal.text:
Spellcaster: [Are you serious? fine, I guess I'll have to do this myself.]

The spellcaster takes out his knife to slash through the spiderwebs and crawls outside.
You sense that the other abductees don't like you.

Spellcaster: [It's clear! come outside.]

You and the abductees crawl outside.

Runaway Scout.title: Kidnapped
Runaway Scout.text: You crawl outside and see that it is clear. You crawl back inside and tell everyone.

Spider Forest.title: Kidnapped
Spider Forest.text:
Spellcaster: [There are people over there, it looks like they sent people to help us, let's go!]

You follow the spellcaster as he walked over to holler at the people.

The spellcaster conjures another light and waves it in his hand.
Spellcaster: [Hey, over here! help!]

The people turns toward you and points at the spellcaster. You notice that they are wearing rags and are wielding weapons. They run towards you.

Spellcaster: [Something's not right, be on your guard.]

They throw their bolas at the spellcaster. He dodges.

Spellcaster: [I don't know what their problem is, but we can't run away from them and the spiders at the same time. Let's lure them into the tunnel and fight them inside, there are only 5 of them.]

Spider Forest Feral.title: Kidnapped
Spider Forest Feral.text:
You take down the feral human and look around. It looks like all of the ferals have gone down, but 4 people are dead as a result.

The spellcaster grabs one of the critically wounded ferals.
Spellcaster: [These people, they don't look particularly starved... They are wearing rags, but in rather clean condition. Let's see if they can talk.
Hey you, why are you trying to hurt us?]

The critically wounded feral woman opens her eyes slowly looks up. She stares at the spellcaster with pleasing eyes and speaks: [You can't leave, stay in your caves! They will bring us food...]

Spellcaster: [What? who brings us food? answer me!]

Feral woman: [The masters aren't going to be happy if you leave, please, stay inside!]

Spellcaster: [Who are the masters? come on.]

Feral woman: [How do you not know? how did you get here?]

The spellcaster lets her go and gives up on trying to communicate.

Spellcaster: [These people are very weird... Who are they and where did they come from? Well, we can't waste any more time. Let's just leave them here and go...]

Ant Hill Outskirt.title: Return to Ant Hill
Ant Hill Outskirt.text:
Leaving the ferals to die, your group finally arrive at the Ant Hill after about an hour of walk.

People come out to meet and greet. Families of the lost ones grieve.

You thank the spellcaster, whose name was Lucid.

You return to your roommates and share your fascinating stories...

Ant Hill Next Week.title: Home
Ant Hill Next Week.text:
It's been a week since the kidnapping incident. People went back to their normal lives, as these kind of things are rather common in Ant Hill.

One of the hunters let you know that the priest of Ant Hill is looking for you.

Ant Hill Temple.title: Ant Hill Temple
Ant Hill Temple.text:
You walk into the Ant Hill Temple, which is a rather large room among the many rooms in the dirt maze. There is an altar made of strange light blue stone in the center and two fireflies by the altar shines the room.
You spot Scobby, a veteran hunter of Ant Hill that you know, who nods at you.
The priest dressed in white robe comes out from the back with Lucid to greet you.

Priest: [Welcome, Every year we select a few scouts for a mission to re-establish connections with our old neighbors. You two had been selected for that job this year, but...]

Ant Hill Temple2.title: Ant Hill Temple
Ant Hill Temple2.text:
Priest: [As you may well know, we have not been successful in communicating with the outside world for 5 years.]

Priest: [That has changed. This man named Lucid has visited us from the outside world.]

He pointed at Lucid, who was crossing his arms in his black leather jacket. He nods.

Priest: [Like I said earlier, we had selected you and Scobby here for the mission to the outside. Instead, it looks like you two will be escorting this man back to his city. We may finally re-establish our connections and regain access to the crafts and spells of bigger settlements to help defend ourselves.]

Priest: [We wanted to send guards to guard him all the way to the city, but this man assures me that he doesn't need help going back. I have talked to him in advance for all our offers for the trade with the city, so just help him with anything he may need. And please, be careful. This is very important.]

Lucid: [When the roads are this dangerous, it's better to move with only a few that know how to move quietly. Shall we depart?]
